parsed.text: This packet contains fallible 4x4 location distributions for red and blue at nodes n0–n3 in panels p0 and p1. Current estimates: p0 — n0: blue peak at cell [0,1], red at [0,3]; n1 and n2: both roles uniform across all 16 cells; n3: blue peak at [1,2], red at [0,1]. Origins labeled "copied_prior_record" or "completed_record" report earlier records (record_time 11 or 12) and are not new executed events. Candidate (command) records k0/k1/k2 are conditional estimates, not events that already occurred. Differences across command branches: in p0 candidate branches the n3 peaks remain on blue [1,2] and red [0,1] with minor numeric differences. In p1 candidate branches n3 varies: k0 concentrates blue on four upper-right cells and red on four upper-left cells; k1 gives uniform distributions; k2 concentrates blue at [1,2] and red at [0,1]. No physical or presence claims are made; numbers describe only the supplied distributions.
